- [ ] **B5** **LLM-driven live commit** — first real bug fixed end-to-end via the LLM path (not the deterministic fallback). This is the biggest single remaining item.
- [ ] **B6** Root-cause diagnosis of the original LLM hang (pilot 1 stuck at 10%). Could be slow model, malformed JSON response, or gateway disconnect. The 45s timeout prevents infinite hang but doesn't fix the underlying cause.
- [ ] **B7** LLM prompt engineering — verify the patch-generation prompt produces valid JSON patches reliably across multiple bug types (not just string-literal swaps).

### C. Live tests (pilot done, 2 not run)
- [x] **C1** Pilot label change — LIVE VERIFIED (`ivx-worker-68a3c572`, commit `a56c0136`)
- [ ] **C2** **Self-repair test (Phase 6)** — inject intentionally failing patch, verify iteration 1 fail → iteration 2 pass → COMPLETED. Unit test exists; live test not run.
- [ ] **C3** **Real chat bug fix (Phase 7)** — the chat ordering defect. Full LLM-driven path: inspect → plan → patch → add regression test → test → commit → owner approval → deploy → Android verify. This is the proof the general path works on a real bug.
- [ ] **C4** Owner-gated deploy approval exercised live (phrase `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`) for an autonomous-coder commit. Pilots were `code_change` mode only.

### D. Cost / resource controls (Phase 12 — NOT started)

- [ ] **E5** Resume-from-checkpoint after worker restart mid-job (currently relies on existing worker restart-recovery; autonomous-coder-specific checkpoint not implemented)
- [ ] **E6** Dead-letter for autonomous-coder jobs that exhaust retries

### F. Rollback (Phase 16 — NOT started)

- [ ] **F2** Production rollback path if `verifyProductionHealth()` fails after a deploy — automatic revert commit + redeploy of prior SHA
